Body lotion: permitted.
21 CFR 74.2334(b) states: "D&C Red No. 34 may be safely used for coloring externally applied cosmetics in amounts consistent with good manufacturing practice." [2].
Use limit: no percentage is stated; the amount is consistent with good manufacturing practice [2].
21 CFR 74.2334(a) states: "The color additive D&C Red No. 34 shall conform in identity and specifications to the requirements of § 74.1334(a)(1) and (b)." [1].
21 CFR 74.2334(c) states: "The label of the color additive shall conform to the requirements of § 70.25 of this chapter." [3].
21 CFR 74.2334(d) states: "All batches of D&C Red No. 34 shall be certified in accordance with regulations in part 80 of this chapter." [4].
21 CFR 82.1334 states: "Calcium salt of 3-hydroxy-4-[(1-sulfo-2 -naphthalenyl)azol-2-naphthalenecarboxylic acid." [5].
21 CFR 82.1334 states: "Sum of volatile matter (at 135 °C) and chlorides and sulfates (calculated as sodium salts), not more than 15 percent. 2-Amino-1-naphthalenesulfonic acid, calcium salt, not more than 0.2 percent. 3-Hydroxy-2-naphthoic acid, not more than 0.4 percent. Subsidiary colors, not more than 4 percent. Total color not less than 85 percent." [6].
21 CFR 70.3(v) states: "The terms externally applied drugs and externally applied cosmetics mean drugs or cosmetics applied only to external parts of the body and not to the lips or any body surface covered by mucous membrane." [7].
21 CFR 82.1050 states: "A batch of a straight color listed in this subpart may be certified, in accordance with the provisions of this part, for use only in drugs and cosmetics, if such batch conforms to the requirements of § 82.5 and to the specifications set forth in this subpart for such color." [8].
